sources.title: Burundi — Bosnia and Herzegovina visa information
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current MFA country entry page expressly gives the inbound Bosnia and Herzegovina visa rule for citizens of Burundi.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the Republic of Burundi are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.

sources.title: Rulebook on the procedure of visa issuance in diplomatic and consular missions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The MFA hosts the operative Rulebook governing short-stay visa issuance to foreign nationals through Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic and consular missions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A foreign national shall submit visa application to the authorized DKP BiH, according to the place of applicant’s residence.

sources.title: Kosovo Visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Diaspora of the Republic of Kosovo
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Republic of Kosovo embassies platform publishes the current closed short-stay visa-exemption list and the required application procedure for other foreign nationals.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You must apply for a Kosovo visa if you wish to visit or transit through the territory of the Republic of Kosovo.

sources.title: EAC Partner States
sources.officialityEvidence: The EAC's current official partner-states page identifies both Burundi and South Sudan as EAC Partner States.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Burundi joined the East African Community in July 2007. South Sudan became a full member in 2016.

sources.title: Visa-Free Entry
sources.officialityEvidence: The EAC's current immigration guidance says all Partner States implement Article 7(1) of the Common Market Protocol's visa-free entry for citizens of other Partner States.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Partner States are implementing Article 7(1) ... provision for visa-free entry of citizens of EAC Partner States.

policies.title: Burundian ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina advance short-stay visa
policies.summary: Bosnia and Herzegovina's MFA expressly requires a visa for Burundian citizens and its governing short-stay procedure requires filing with the competent diplomatic or consular mission.
conditions: Submit the visitor-visa application to the competent Bosnia and Herzegovina diplomatic or consular mission according to the applicant's residence. The ordinary Burundian-nationality entry row requires a visa.

The narrow individual emergency border-visa provisions do not establish a nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route. Work, residence, transit, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Burundian ordinary passports: Kosovo advance short-stay visa
policies.summary: Kosovo's current closed visa-exemption list does not include Burundi, and its Foreign Ministry requires other foreign nationals to use the in-person diplomatic or consular visa process before a visit.
conditions: Submit the short-stay visa application in person to the relevant Kosovo diplomatic or consular mission no later than three months before the intended visit. Burundi is not in the current official exemption list, and no listed special-category exemption is inferred here.
This is an advance consular route, not an eVisa or nationality-wide visa-on-arrival route. Residence, work, transit, special documents, carrier requirements and final admission remain separate.

policies.title: Burundian ordinary passports: South Sudan EAC visa-free entry
policies.summary: Burundi and South Sudan are EAC Partner States, and current EAC immigration guidance says Article 7(1) is implemented as visa-free entry for citizens of other Partner States.
conditions: This is the EAC Partner-State ordinary-passport visitor-entry baseline. Carry the travel document required at the border and comply with immigration, public-health, carrier and final-admission conditions.
It does not establish work, residence, diplomatic or other special-document treatment, nor guarantee current border-opening or individual admission.

conflicts.explanation: The fallback calls this visa_on_arrival, but current EAC immigration guidance records visa-free entry for citizens of all EAC Partner States; Burundi and South Sudan are both current Partner States.
